items.title: Mycoria
items.description: Overlay network where the IPv6 address is the key: Easily share address + public key via a DNS AAAA record or map names locally. Secure by default (firewall included). BSD-3 license. Written in Go.

repo_info.description: Mycoria is an open and secure overlay network that connects all participants. It values freedom of connectivity and aims to imitate the curious and adventurous spirit of the early Internet.

repo_info.description: Kubernetes Operator for Chisel

items.title: Ngrok-operator
items.description: Ngrok but integrated with Kubernetes, allows developers on private Kubernetes to easily access their services via Ngrok.

repo_info.description: Expose your service in Kubernetes to the Internet with Ngrok easily! Automatically reload ngrok sessions after expired!
